description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called OnboardingWizardView used for onboarding and connecting a gateway device via QR code or manual setup, including handling states, user interactions, and external dependencies.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: An enumeration representing different steps in the onboarding process with helper properties for navigation and UI labels.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing the onboarding flow for connecting a gateway via QR code or manual configuration, handling states, user interactions, alerts, and external dependencies.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a selectable row for choosing connection modes during onboarding.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Handles a scanned QR code link, updating connection parameters accordingly.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Initiates the QR code scanner and resets relevant states.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Resumes the connection process after user approval during device pairing.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing if the conditions are met.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message string from image data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Advances the onboarding flow from the intro step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates to the previous step in the onboarding flow.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway device.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Sets the selected connection mode and applies default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default configuration based on the selected connection mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Checks if a discovered gateway has a resolvable host address.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a gateway manually using specified host and port.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last gateway connection attempt, optionally silently.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Saves the gateway token and password securely.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Saves the bootstrap token for the gateway.

calls: UIApplication.shared.sendAction(#selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder), to: nil, from: nil, for: nil)
